scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @lostluggage/server" "npm run dev -w @lostluggage/client"
scripts.test: npm test -w @lostluggage/sim && npm test -w @lostluggage/server && npm test -w @lostluggage/client
